title: 20,000 players and a year and a half of testing later, we’ve launched Master of Dungeon, a AI D&D-style text RPG
author: Tigeline
selftext:
My brother and I have spent the last year and a half of evenings and weekends building Master of Dungeon, a text RPG that tries to capture the feeling of sitting down for a D&D session. We’ve been testing and tweaking it with players the whole way (over 15,000 of you so far!), and we finally decided it was ready to launch. It’s been a lot of late nights, so every positive review on the store genuinely means the world to us.

How did it start? We’re two brothers who just couldn’t find time for D&D with our friends anymore, and we really missed those sessions. Luckily, we’ve been making games for years, so we figured: why not build something that lets us go on those adventures anyway, and make up for all the sessions we never got to play? That’s how Master of Dungeon happened.

Since launch, you’ve sent us loads of suggestions and feedback, so we went ahead and added a bunch of new stuff:

1. **Companions:** tame your own pet and bring it along on your adventures.
2. **Multiplayer:** team up with your friends and fight side by side.
3. **Character classes:** Paladin, Warrior, Rogue and Monk.
4. **Plus a whole bunch of new adventures.**

Want to give it a shot?  
iOS: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/master-of-dungeon-ai-text-rpg/id6785556161](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/master-of-dungeon-ai-text-rpg/id6785556161)  
Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bitforge.mastersofdungeon&hl=en](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bitforge.mastersofdungeon&hl=en)

And if you’re curious how the game came together, we’ve been documenting the whole journey in the #devlog channel on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/HHBBqpkvGW) :) It goes all the way back to March 2025, so there’s plenty to dig through 🙂

Would love to hear what you think!

comments.author: izhy
comments.body: You have my sword ;) - good luck

comments.author: WolfedUpLlama
comments.body: I’m curious is the DnD content (stories, etc) AI generated and if so how does your player base feel about that?

replies.author: Tigeline
replies.body: Hey, thanks for comment :) the stories are written using a special “key” system, rather than in a traditional book-like format. They’re more like a series of objectives that the player needs to complete to progress further. As for the stories themselves, we mostly write them ourselves with help from the community (we have a few people who help write them with us).
